## Weekly Update - 2026-10-11
Hey <@&1424461167883194418> — a lot got added this week. Here’s the useful part.

🌱 **Models & catalog**
FLUX.3 Image, Seedream 5.0 Flash, Nano Banana 2.1, Grok Imagine Video 1.5 Lite, Eleven v4 and v4 Turbo, Claude Haiku 5.5, Mistral Large 4, Step 5 Preview, GPT-6 Luna Decisions, and MAI voice and transcription models were added. Model search, capability filters, dollar prices, clearer billing units, and explicit `paid_only` labels should make the catalog less of a guessing game.

🛠️ **APIs & agents**
Chat text models were added to [`/v1/responses`](https://github.com/pollinations/pollinations/pull/16811). Gemini’s parallel tool calls and streamed arguments got better handling; document blocks and PDF support expanded across Claude and GPT routes. Growing agent sessions also got better prompt-cache reuse.

🎨 **Media**
The rebuilt [Play page](https://github.com/pollinations/pollinations/pull/16213) puts image, video, and audio generation together, with uploads, previews, downloads, and request-matching API URLs. The SDK gained video reference-media options, and large generation request bodies can pass the former 32 MiB limit.

🐝 **Pollen & Quests**
Keys gained model-category permissions and a Quest-Pollen-only option. x402 prepaid keys gained flexible amounts; video and community-model Quests were added. CLI output now separates wallet Pollen from key budgets — two numbers that really ought to look different.

🧰 **Builders & community**
Community text endpoints no longer need upstream streaming to serve streaming clients. Polli CLI follow-ups retain context, uploads retain filenames, and Agent Skills and MCP discovery were added. Pi Workbench, voice mysteries, party games, and study-song apps joined the listings. News also gained a dated model and API changelog.
